name: @hb/ui
description: App-agnostic shared design system (single live source). Lead app: Keksdose.
_sideEffects: The barrel (src/index.ts) re-exports EVERY component, including components/chart, which statically imports recharts. Without this field a bundler must assume each of those modules has side effects, so it cannot drop the unused ones: importing a Button from '@hb/ui' dragged all 433KB of recharts into the consumer's ENTRY chunk, and Keksdose was preloading it on every page load, login included. Nothing in src/ imports for side effects (no bare imports, no CSS imports from JS, no module-level global writes) — the token stylesheet is its own './tokens.css' export — so this is safe. CSS is still listed so any future stylesheet survives.
